Request6c21ad7c-490d-40eb-be1e-99324724ae8a source correction published on codex/document-save-settlement. Tests-first58053e60 adds DocumentSaveSheetProbeTests.swift; product9663c0e8 changes only DocumentSheets.swift. makeNSView and updateNSView now both call refreshCapture(on:): capture closure is replaced with current requestID/report function and weak current workspace, then view.window is reported immediately if present. Existing viewDidMoveToWindow still reports through the refreshed closure. Workspace request/phase/presentation identity guards unchanged.

Probe type/helper is internal for a bounded reporting seam. Two tests UNRUN: same already-attached NSView refreshed from owner/request A to B reports B immediately without a move event and on subsequent move; capture closure does not retain old workspace. The reuse test constructs a tiny hidden deferred AppKit window on A when run; no native sheet or backend I/O, but not a pure Foundation test. B executed no tests/builds/apps/GPU work. git diff --check passed; compile/test verification pending.

No wider presentation rewrite, timers or changed detach semantics. Both prior GUI failures remain, and A has not yet accepted the native-detachment candidate. Native parent notification ordering and existing-file Replace still require A isolated GUI validation. No AppModel/ContentView changes in this correction, no heartbeat restart or writer changes. A sole main integration.
